lines.text: What kind of AGI do we want to build?
Ask most people: a mind of its own, arriving one day, standing apart from us.
But first: what is AGI actually made of?
The LLM: the language model, the raw intelligence.
A HARNESS: the layer wrapped around it.
HOOKS: automatic checks, firing at the right moment.
TOOLS: what it can reach and do.
Stand them apart from you, owned by someone else: ARTIFICIAL.
Wear the same parts as your digital CORTEX: AUGMENTED.
One difference: who owns the layer.
So the question was never only when AGI arrives.
It's where we started: what kind of AGI do we want to build?
